intro: Professionals and everyday users convert milliliters (mL) to tablespoons (us) (tbsp) when working across metric and us_customary standards in culinary recipe scaling, beverage bottling, laboratory reagent preparation, and fluid tank capacity sizing. One milliliter equals 0.067628 tablespoons (us), while 1 tablespoon (us) equals 14.786765 milliliters. Whether you are verifying volume & liquid specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: US Customary vs. British Imperial Liquid Volume Trap
items: US Customary and UK Imperial liquid units share identical names but have different physical volumes: 1 US Gallon is 3.78541 L (128 US fl oz), whereas 1 UK Imperial Gallon is 4.54609 L (160 Imp fl oz) — a 20.1% difference.

Similarly, 1 US Pint contains 16 US fluid ounces (473.18 mL), while 1 British Imperial Pint contains 20 Imperial fluid ounces (568.26 mL). Always verify whether your recipe, pump datasheet, or vehicle spec sheet uses US or UK standards.

faqs.question: How many tablespoons (us) (tbsp) are in 1 milliliter (mL)?
faqs.answer: There are 0.06762805 tablespoons (us) (tbsp) in 1 milliliter (mL), which rounds to 0.0676 tbsp for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 tablespoon (us) equals 14.786765 milliliters.

faqs.question: How do I convert milliliters to tablespoons (us) (mL to tbsp)?
faqs.answer: To convert milliliters to tablespoons (us), use the formula: tbsp = mL × 0.06762805. For example, converting 100 mL gives 6.7628 tbsp.

faqs.question: What is 100 milliliters in tablespoons (us)?
faqs.answer: 100 milliliters (mL) equals exactly 6.7628 tablespoons (us) (tbsp) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
